segments.text: I write merely to say that I send up to
C. I suppose you will not get them till
. Very many thanks for the loan.— The Sections of all biggest genera in each order in the 3 vols. (which include all the least favourable orders) behave as I wish them, but not very strongly.—

with hesitation gives same verdict as you but confines his verdict to very small genera.— He really writes a very sensible letter on subject. He never thought of case before, but seems now to have thought deliberately & consulted some
